title: 3-Day Full-Body Dumbbell Program by Google
author: De B.
desc: Unlock your strength with the 3-Day Full-Body Dumbbell Program by Google. Designed for beginners, this one-week program incorporates essential dumbbell exercises that target all major muscle groups, ensuring a balanced workout. With three training days each week, you'll perform movements like Goblet Squats, Bent Over Rows, and Overhead Presses to build muscle and enhance strength. Get ready to transform your fitness routine with effective, equipment-friendly workouts that fit seamlessly into your schedule!

ex.note: Or Raised Legs Push-ups (to near failure)
